title: Account Executive - SMB
description:

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

You'll generate a large share of your own pipeline and work alongside the SDR team on the rest, then take every deal from first conversation to close.

  • Run efficient, repeatable discovery and demos that get a prospect to a decision quickly

At Klim, we work with farmers and businesses to make regenerative agriculture a scalable and economically viable part of the food system. Your coaching will cover practical growth decisions including pricing, packaging, positioning, offers, email strategy, funnels, and retention.  As the first person in this role, you will build the playbooks, programs, and operating model that can eventually scale across the segment.  The role combines customer coaching, data analysis, facilitation, experimentation, and commercial ownership in a remote global environment. Advise customers on revenue-driving decisions such as pricing, packaging, positioning, offer design, email and funnel strategy, and retention mechanics.  Monitor customer data and cohort behavior to identify accounts showing signs of risk before they churn.  Analyze retention curves, funnel performance, and customer behavior to determine which coaching interventions are producing meaningful results.

title: Strategic Account Manager
description: Localisation : Lyon, France    Rémunération : 50-75 k€ + BSPCE (Stock Options)       À propos de nous   Chez Wavo, nous construisons le futur du financement de stocks. Pour les PME, le stock est à la fois une opportunité et une contrainte. Il immobilise de la trésorerie, freine la croissance et crée du risque. Les solutions de financement traditionnelles sont lentes, rigides et basées sur l’historique financier plutôt que sur le potentiel business en temps réel.  Nous adoptons une approche différente. Wavo achète et finance les stocks en amont, sans dette ni garantie personnelle. Les entreprises peuvent ainsi accélérer leur croissance, améliorer leur trésorerie et se concentrer sur leur développement, sans friction financière.  Nous avons levé 3,5M€ pour accélérer notre expansion et déployer notre modèle auprès de plus d’entreprises. Nous sommes soutenus par des investisseurs et des leaders du secteur qui nous donnent les moyens d’aller vite. Notre objectif est clair : devenir la référence du financement de stocks intégré en Europe.  Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons un Strategic Account Manager, pour accompagner nos clients de bout en bout et jouer un rôle central dans l’exécution et la qualité de notre modèle.      Ce que tu feras   En tant que Strategic Account Manager chez Wavo, tu prendras en charge la relation client dans la durée, depuis les premiers échanges jusqu’au suivi des financements dans le temps. Il s’agit d’un rôle central, au croisement du commercial, de l’analyse et de l’opérationnel.     Tu interviendras en amont sur la qualification des prospects, principalement issus de l’inbound. À travers des échanges structurés, tu chercheras à comprendre le business des entreprises, la nature de leurs produits, leur modèle économique et leur capacité à s’inscrire dans notre solution. Ton rôle sera d’évaluer si Wavo est pertinent pour eux, et dans quelles conditions.     Lorsque le dossier avance, tu travailleras sur l’analyse des données mises à disposit

Pre-Sales(프리세일즈)부터 POC, Implementation(구축 및 연동), Adoption(활성화), Expansion/Renewal(재계약 및 확장)에 이르는 고객 라이프사이클 전반을 주도합니다.  고객사의 실무진부터 Manager, Director, CTO, Data/Product 조직과 직접 소통하며 솔루션을 설계하고 프로젝트를 성공적으로 완수합니다. 나아가 한국 시장 CSM 팀을 이끌며 조직 체계와 Best Practice를 구축할 핵심 리더십을 발휘하게 됩니다.      주요 업무 (Responsibilites)    ① Enterprise Customer Success 관리    한국 엔터프라이즈 고객의 전반적인 CSM 총괄  고객의 비즈니스 목표 및 데이터 활용 시나리오를 심층 분석하고, C-Level(CTO 등) 및 주요 의사결정권자와의 장기적 신뢰 관계 구축  정기적인 비즈니스 리뷰(EBR/QBR)를 통해 리스크 사전 예방, 제품 사용률(Adoption) 제고, 갱신(Renewal) 및 업셀(Upsell) 기회 발굴       ② 솔루션 컨설팅 & Pre-Sales 지원    엔터프라이즈 고객 대상 제품 데모, 테크니컬 워크숍 주도 및 비즈니스 케이스 분석  SDK, API, 데이터 파이프라인, ETL, 데이터 아키텍처 기반의 고객 맞춤형 기술 솔루션 설계  POC 프로젝트 설계, 실행 및 결과 브리핑, 고객 요구사항의 내부 프로덕트/엔지니어링 사양화       ③ POC & Implementation 프로젝트 매니지먼트    온보딩/도입 프로젝트 및 POC의 엔드투엔드(End-to-End) 총괄 관리  일정, 마일스톤, 리스크 및 이슈 관리  고객사, 영업, 제품, 개발, 테크 서포트 등 유관 부서와의 유기적인 크로스펑셔널(Cross-functional) 협업 및 선제적 문제 해결       ④ 테크니컬 고객 서포트 및 이슈 해결    SDK/API, 이벤트·유저 데이터, ETL, DW, BI/Analytics, Cloud/SaaS 기술 아키텍처에 대한 이해 기반 커뮤니케이션  고객 기술 이슈 발생 시 원인 분석, 영향도 파악, 유관 팀 조율 및 최종 해결 방안 커뮤니케이션 주도 (단순 전달자 역할 지양)       ⑤ 비즈니스 & 데이터 컨설팅    고객의 기능 요구를 넘어 비즈니스 목적, 기대 ROI를 발굴하여 기술 솔루션과 연결  데이터 기반 유저 리텐션 개선, LiveOps 최적화, 마케팅 성과 향상, A/B 테스팅, Data/AI 활용 운영 효율화 제안       ⑥ 팀 리더십 & 조직 관리    Customer Success, 솔루션, 분석가 팀 매니징 및 멘토링  고객 배정 및 프로젝트 운영 프로세스 수립, 팀 Best Practice 구축 및 팀 KPI/비즈니스 성과 달성 책임       Requirements     5~10년 이상 의 관련 업무 경력 (Enterprise B2B SaaS, 솔루션 컨설팅, 테크니컬 CSM 등)  B2B Enterprise 고객 대응 경험 및 팀 매니징(팀 리딩) 경험  고객사의 Manager, Director, CTO 등 고위 의사결정권자와 원활한 비즈니스 및 기술 소통이 가능하신 분  이벤트 데이터(Event Data), 유저 데이터(User Data), BI/Analytics, 데이터 아키텍처, SDK/API 및 ETL에 대한 이해도를 갖추신 분  POC 및 엔터프라이즈 Implementation 프로젝트를 독립적으로 이끌고 리스크를 주도적으로 해결할 수 있는 역량  높은 비즈니스 감각으로 고객의 ROI/비즈니스 임팩트를 분석할 수 있는 역량

title: Account Management Team Lead
description: WHO WE ARE      Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.     Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.  Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. You would own the relationship end-to-end: from onboarding a new client, to making sure their campaigns are live and hitting performance targets, to presenting QBRs and identifying growth opportunities. Day-to-day, this means coordinating closely with the Campaign Management team on performance and optimizations and with Sales on account expansion.     This is a player-coach role: you will lead and grow the APAC AM team while also directly owning a portfolio of strategic clients. description: This is not a typical Customer Success role. title: Implementation Manager

Conduct remote training sessions and produce documentation (guides, videos, help articles) adapted to each client profile.  Collect structured feedback from clients post-implementation and surface product gaps to the Product team.  Contribute to scaling our onboarding methodology: templates, playbooks, and automation of repetitive tasks. Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a Customer Evidence Manager to own and drive the customer-proof infrastructure that powers our managed sales motion. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercially minded, creatively grounded customer marketer who understands that the value of a customer story is not that it gets published — it is that it protects customer trust, gives buyers credible, accurate proof and moves a deal forward. You are the editorial authority on what good looks like, not the person writing every script: execution (writing, video, design) is delivered through agency partners you brief and direct.

Enterprise buyers do not decide on brand claims. They decide on credible proof from organizations like theirs: customer stories, ROI evidence, video testimonials, peer reviews, and competitive validation. In this role, you will produce that evidence and ensure it reaches sellers and customers at the moments it can have the greatest commercial impact.

You will own the program outcomes and operational rigor — setting the creative and editorial bar for what makes a great customer story, directing the agency partners who produce the work, and deploying that proof into active deals — and measuring evidence's impact on pipeline, win rates, and sales-cycle velocity. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Campaign Enablement, and product teams to prioritize proof for the full suite of Dropbox products and solutions, including AI capabilities, multi-product platform adoption, and priority vertical workflows. You will get substantial senior Sales and Marketing leadership exposure and a direct, measurable line to revenue during a pivotal shift in how Dropbox goes to market.

title: Business Development Manager, EU Airport transfers (all genders)
description:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Business Development Manager, focus on Market Expansion, build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to building a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

title: (Senior) Creator Marketing Coordinator (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Du weißt, was erfolgreiche Creator-Kampagnen ausmacht, erkennst Trends bevor sie viral gehen und hast ein Gespür für starke Markenstrategien? Dann bist du hier genau richtig!

In dieser Rolle bringst du dein strategisches Know-how ein, arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Kunden und Creators und gestaltest innovative Marketingansätze, die echten Impact haben. 

Wenn du Lust hast, die Zukunft der Creator Economy mitzugestalten und deine Expertise auf das nächste Level zu heben – let’s talk!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Strategische Kampagnensteuerung: Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen mit Fokus auf Performance und Brand Awareness
  • Enge Kundenbetreuung: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Key Account Management zur Sicherstellung der individuellen Kundenstrategie
  • Projektmanagement: Erstellung von wöchentlichen Updates, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Kundenterminen sowie Entwicklung langfristiger Kundenbindungsmaßnahmen
  • Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen: Identifikation von Trends, Analyse des Wettbewerbsumfeldes und Ableitung strategischer Maßnahmen
  • Budget- & Margenverantwortung: Steuerung und Kontrolle von Kosten, Budgets und Margenzielen zur Sicherstellung der wirtschaftlichen Effizienz

title: Head of Product Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du bist die Brücke zwischen unserer Produktentwicklung und einem der stärksten Performance-Marketing-Teams im europäischen D2C: Jeder Schuh verlässt bei dir die Entwicklung mit fertiger Launch-Story, belegten Aussagen und Creative-Angles. Und du baust den Insight-Motor auf, der aus Millionen Ad-Kommentaren und einem eigenen Kunden-Panel die Produkt-Briefs von morgen macht. Bei Pammys ist Product Marketing keine Übersetzungs-Abteilung — es sitzt im Produktbereich und entscheidet, welches Produkt für welche Nische gebaut wird.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du planst und steuerst unsere Produktlaunches: Timing, Positionierung, Abstimmung mit Performance, Creator-Team, CRM und Shop
  • Du baust unsere Insights-Funktion auf: ein eigenes Kunden-Panel, Segmentierung, qualitative Interviews — und die systematische Auswertung von Community- und Anzeigen-Feedback
  • Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Produkt-Briefs: Passform- und Komfort-Themen, Wünsche, nächste Modell-Ideen — direkt in die Produktentwicklung und zum Founder
  • Du lieferst Botschaft und Angle-Hypothesen an das Creative-Team — Testergebnisse aus den Kampagnen fließen zurück in deinen Insight-Kreislauf
  • Du entwickelst pro Produkt die Kernbotschaft: welches Problem es löst, für wen, warum jetzt – und briefst damit Creative-Team und Creator

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, customer friendly responses under regulatory constraints</

description:
About SoSafe

SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.

Your Role: Drive Sales Performance & Velocity

As Revenue Operations Manager for Sales Excellence, you will be the strategic partner to our Sales leadership and the operational engine behind our Account Executives. Across the SaaS industry, sales cycles have recently increased by 3-4 weeks on average. Furthermore, industry-wide SQL to Closed-Won conversion rates have dropped. Your core mission is to counteract these market headwinds by optimizing our sales mechanics, critical processes, and pipeline management.

You will ensure that our AEs spend less time on administrative friction and more time executing a frictionless, high-converting sales process tailored to our mid-market European buyers.

What you will own (key responsibilities)

  • Operationalize the 2026 ICP: Drive strict alignment with our new Ideal Customer Profile, focusing our AE efforts on corporate to mid-enterprise EU organizations with 500 to 5,000 employees. Equip the sales team to prioritize accounts in regulated industries (e.g., Manufacturing, Finance, Healthcare) that are driven by compliance mandates like NIS2 and DORA.

  • Optimize our Buyer Journey: Tailor our Salesforce deal stages and qualification methodology to engage the right stakeholders at the right time. Specifically, build workflows that help AEs navigate the Head of IT, who acts as the primary decision-maker in our core mid-market deals.
